mapper.update: update blv_redeem_codes set used_count = used_count + 1, modified_at = now() where id = #{id} and used_count < max_uses

update brand set blue_begain_at = if(blue_end_at >= now(), blue_begain_at, now()), blue_end_at = if(blue_end_at >= now(), DATE_ADD(blue_end_at, INTERVAL #{days} DAY), DATE_ADD(now(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)), modified_at = now() where customer_id = #{userId}
